format: Small traditional restaurant design (~7,700-8,500 sq ft buffet restaurant), not including cost of land and site work

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a franchised restaurant ranges from $3,631,328 to $4,508,130 for a small traditional restaurant design ... These ranges include $1,230,000 to $1,370,000 that must or may be paid to the franchisor and its affiliates for the small traditional restaurant design

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee, regardless of building design, is $50,000, payable as follows: $20,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement, $15,000 when we notify you of site approval for the Restaurant, and $15,000 at least 14 days before opening the Restaurant.
fee.note: VetFran: 50% discount of the initial franchise fee for qualifying veterans. Existing franchisees (1+ year) signing a new Development Agreement by April 15, 2027 pay an initial franchise fee of only $15,000 per Restaurant under construction within 18 months. Development fee $20,000 per Restaurant, credited against the initial franchise fee. Prorated fee for terms shorter than the standard 15 years.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4% of Gross Sales Weekly by electronic funds transfer See Note 2

adFund.quote: Advertising Contributions 2% - 6% of Gross Sales – Currently 2.4% Weekly by electronic funds transfer
adFund.note: Currently 2.4%, range 2% to 6% of Gross Sales. Opening Advertising $10,000 - $15,000 before and during the first 90 days after opening.

item19.note: Operating income = gross sales minus food cost, labor-related expenses and controllable expenses (utilities, maintenance, sanitation) only. Excludes rent/land/building/equipment, debt service, depreciation, advertising, administrative expenses, taxes, licenses, insurance and the 4% royalty, so it overstates profit. Table 1 covers 315 franchised Restaurants; excludes 7 that left the system, 1 open less than 6 months and 27 that had not reported; 11 Restaurants open 6-12 months were annualized.

special: Pre-opening purchases from the franchisor's affiliate Coastal (equipment, signs, build-out): estimated $530,000 to $1,500,000 if you use Coastal. New Development Incentive Program (agreements signed by July 31, 2027, opened within 24 months): franchisor reimburses 3% of Gross Sales in year 1, 2% in year 2 and 1% in year 3, plus up to $15,000 of training costs for up to 3 managers (up to $45,000). Item 7 excludes land and site work; if leased, annual rent may approximate 9% to 12% of total acquisition and construction cost.
